segs.en: Luke likes math problems, so he has asked you to solve this problem.

zh.ai: Luke 喜欢数学题，所以他请你解决这道题。

segs.en: Given a vector $$$\langle x,y \rangle$$$, what is the total number of nonempty sequences of vectors $$$\{a_i\}_{i=0}^n$$$ such that:

zh.ai: 给定一个向量 $$$\langle x,y \rangle$$$，满足以下条件的非空向量序列 $$$\{a_i\}_{i=0}^n$$$ 的总数是多少：

segs.en: All vectors in $$$\{a_i\}$$$ have only integer entries.

zh.ai: $$$\{a_i\}$$$ 中的所有向量的元素均为整数。

segs.en: Moreover, he will give you $$$Q$$$ queries, and you need to output the answer for each of these $$$\mod 10^9 + 7$$$ (a prime).

zh.ai: 此外，他还会给你 $$$Q$$$ 个询问，你需要对每个询问输出答案，模数为 $$$\mod 10^9 + 7$$$(一个质数)。

segs.en: Note that for vector $$$v$$$ of dimension $$$n$$$, $$$||v||_2 = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^n v_i^2}$$$.

An integer $$$Q$$$, $$$1 \leq Q \leq 10^6$$$ which gives the number of queries. $$$Q$$$ lines follow, each with two space separated integers $$$x_i$$$ and $$$y_i$$$, $$$0 \leq |x_i|, |y_i| \leq 10^6$$$, representing the $$$i$$$th query.

zh.ai: 一个整数 $$$Q$$$，$$$1 \leq Q \leq 10^6$$$，表示查询的数量。随后给出 $$$Q$$$ 行，每行包含两个由空格分隔的整数 $$$x_i$$$ 和 $$$y_i$$$，$$$0 \leq |x_i|, |y_i| \leq 10^6$$$，表示第 $$$i$$$ 次查询。

segs.en: On the $$$i$$$th line output the total number of nonempty sequence of vectors that satisfy the above properties for $$$\langle x_i,y_i \rangle$$$.

zh.ai: 在第 $$$i$$$ 行输出对于 $$$\langle x_i,y_i \rangle$$$ 满足上述性质的非空向量序列总数。
G. 刻意构造的数组性质

segs.en: Problem-writers love coming up with incredibly specific, completely useless properties of an arrays of numbers that they want you to compute for them. Now, we can't have an ICPC tryout contest without one of those problems so here is an especially contrived example to compute:

zh.ai: 出题人总喜欢想出一些极其具体、完全没用的数字数组性质，然后让你替他们计算。既然没有这类题目的 ICPC 选拔赛就不完整，那么下面给出一道尤其牵强的题目供你计算：

segs.en: For a given array $$$A$$$, define $$$\psi(A)$$$ as the number of ways to negate certain elements of $$$A$$$ such that the sum of the elements of $$$A$$$ is now $$$0$$$. For example, $$$\psi([1, 1]) = 2$$$ because you can negate the first element and the array will then be $$$[-1, 1]$$$ which has a sum of $$$0$$$ or you can negate the second element making the array $$$[1, -1]$$$ which also has a sum of $$$0$$$.

zh.ai: 对于给定数组 $$$A$$$，定义 $$$\psi(A)$$$ 为将 $$$A$$$ 中的某些元素取相反数，使得 $$$A$$$ 中元素的和变为 $$$0$$$ 的方法数。例如，$$$\psi([1, 1]) = 2$$$，因为你可以将第一个元素取相反数，此时数组变为 $$$[-1, 1]$$$，其元素和为 $$$0$$$；或者将第二个元素取相反数，使数组变为 $$$[1, -1]$$$，其元素和同样为 $$$0$$$。

segs.en: Given an array $$$A$$$ of $$$n$$$ positive integers, let $$$S$$$ be the set of all contiguous, non-empty subarrays of $$$A$$$ (aka all arrays of the form $$$a_i, a_{i+1}, \dots a_j$$$ where $$$1 \leq i \leq j \leq n$$$ where two subarrays are considered different if they start and/or end at different indices, even if the values within the subarray are the same), compute the sum of $$$\psi(x)$$$ for all $$$x \in S$$$ aka $$$\sum\limits_{x \in S}\psi(x)$$$.

zh.ai: 给定一个包含$$$n$$$个正整数的数组$$$A$$$，令$$$S$$$表示$$$A$$$的所有连续非空子数组构成的集合(也就是所有形如$$$a_i, a_{i+1}, \dots a_j$$$且满足$$$1 \leq i \leq j \leq n$$$的数组；如果两个子数组的起始位置和/或结束位置不同，即使其中的数值相同，也将它们视为不同的子数组)，求所有$$$x \in S$$$(即$$$\sum\limits_{x \in S}\psi(x)$$$)的$$$\psi(x)$$$之和。

segs.en: Note this number may be very large, so print it modulo $$$10^9 + 7$$$.

zh.ai: 注意这个数可能非常大，因此请输出它对 $$$10^9 + 7$$$ 取模的结果。

segs.en: The first line will contain a single integer $$$n$$$, representing the number of elements in the array ($$$1 \leq n \leq 1000$$$).

zh.ai: 第一行将包含一个整数 $$$n$$$，表示数组中的元素个数($$$1 \leq n \leq 1000$$$)。

segs.en: The second line will contain $$$n$$$ space-separated positive integers, $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ where $$$1 \leq a_i \leq 1000$$$. It is also guaranteed that $$$a_1 + a_2 + \dots + a_n \leq 10000$$$.

zh.ai: 第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个以空格分隔的正整数 $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$，其中 $$$1 \leq a_i \leq 1000$$$。此外，保证 $$$a_1 + a_2 + \dots + a_n \leq 10000$$$。

segs.en: Output a single integer, the sum modulo $$$10^{9} + 7$$$ of $$$\psi(x)$$$ for all $$$x \in S$$$ where $$$S$$$ is the set of all contiguous, non-empty subarrays of the initial array.

zh.ai: 输出一个整数：对所有 $$$x \in S$$$ 对应的 $$$\psi(x)$$$ 求和，并对 $$$10^{9} + 7$$$ 取模，其中 $$$S$$$ 是初始数组中所有连续且非空子数组组成的集合。
